problem: make_vzip_recipe mutates live Builder candidates member-by-member before the full recipe is known to succeed. A later unsupported/unreproducible member can return None after earlier candidate mutation. Reachability sweeping is insufficient because the earlier raw hash may already be live from another file.

mechanism.name: transactional candidate overlay
mechanism.rule: Stage per-content-SHA candidate deltas for one VZIP recipe and merge them into Builder.cands only after make_vzip_recipe returns a complete recipe. On None/exception, discard staging.
mechanism.memory_refinement: When a staged hash already exists in Builder.cands, reuse the live Candidate.raw object and any already-owned exact Deflate stream object instead of retaining duplicate bytes in staging. New raw/stream bytes are retained only when they are genuinely new candidate state.
mechanism.invariant: Successful recipe state must be byte/semantic equivalent to direct add_content calls: same returned hashes, hints, exact-Deflate stream identities/counts, recipe object and downstream archive semantics.

lower_rung_evidence.real_zip_success: stored + deflate-6 + deflate-9 recipe and final candidate state exactly equal under direct vs staged semantics
lower_rung_evidence.real_zip_late_failure: stored first member followed by BZIP2 member returns None; transactional live state unchanged while current direct callback mutates an existing candidate hint

carrying_cost_hostile.shape: 1000 existing unique 64KiB candidates replayed as fresh duplicate byte objects through a failing recipe callback

controls: Do not replace transaction isolation with mark-and-sweep; reachable candidate hints/Deflate observations can be poisoned by an abandoned recipe.
Do not alter VZIP reader grammar, file storage semantics, format revision, explicit ZIP/WHL admission, >=8-container pack policy, or exception behavior.
Do not catch new exception classes merely to force fallback; this change owns mutation isolation only.
next_decisive_action: Implement the overlay in Builder, add focused successful-merge/failure-isolation/preexisting-candidate tests, then run exact same-source archive/tree/bytes/RSS/wall controls before product promotion.
